suppress.notes: file name: spring-security-crypto-5.8.*.jar The data serialized by the application is trusted NOTE: the vendor's position is that untrusted data is not an intended use case. The product's behavior will not be changed because some users rely on deserialization of trusted data.
file name: spring-*-5.3.39.jar CVE-2024-38820 - DataBinder is used to bind request parameters to JavaBean objects. The vulnerability is not exploitable by SMP usage of the library.

file name: spring-web-5.3.*.jar CVE-2016-1000027 - The data serialized by the application are from authenticated users and trusted CVE-2025-41234 - The application does not set a “Content-Disposition” response header and filenames are not derived from user-supplied input. CVE-2025-41242 - SMP does not server static resources with Spring resource handling. CVE-2024-38820: see below the spring-*-5.3.39.jar for the same issue explanation

file name: snakeyaml-1.30.jar The vulnerability is not impacting smp.war, because is part of spring boot - intended only for demo and testing. Also Yaml configuration is not exposed to external users.

file name: jackson-databind-2.15.2.jar The vulnerability is not exploitable by SMP usage of the library. NOTE: the vendor's perspective is that this is not a valid vulnerability report, because the steps of constructing a cyclic data structure and trying to serialize it cannot be achieved by an external attacker.
file name: tomcat-embed-websocket-9.0.x.jar The vulnerability is not impacting smp.war, because is part of spring boot - intended only for demo and testing.

File name: joda-time-2.x This is transitive library of the 2WaySec, WSS4J 2.4.x: Check if this is needed when using WSS4J is upgrades and is not directly used by the 2waySSL library. NOTE: Currently the latest version 2.12.7 still report the same issue. This is disputed by multiple third parties who believe there was not reasonable evidence to determine the existence of a vulnerability.

file name: protobuf-java-3.25.1.jar This is the transitive library of the mysql-connector-j:jar:8.4.0: Check if this is needed when using Mysql-connector-java is upgrades. The is added only for the spring boot demo module which is used only for the Demo and testing. Final smp.war artefact does not include this library.

file name: harmonysmp-angular-*.jar Maven wrapper for the project's Angular UI. Its module version collides with the CPE for the AngularJS / Angular 2.x framework, so these CVEs are reported against this module by mistake. The real Angular runtime version lives in smp-angular/package.json (covered by npm audit).

file name: harmonysmp-*.war: spring-*.jar OWASP scans jars embedded inside smp.war and reports them with the dependency name "harmonysmp-X.Y.Z.war: spring-core-5.3.39.jar" but with an EMPTY packageUrl field, so the per-packageUrl suppression above does not match. This filePath regex catches the war-bundled copies. Same EOL Spring 5.3.x rationale as the parent suppression.
